_comment: Single source of truth for paths deliberately NOT localized. Consumed by the i18n CI guards (KZ-602) and any rg/pseudo-locale wrapper — do not hardcode these globs anywhere else. Everything here stays ru-only: no t()/<Trans>, Cyrillic string literals are expected. /admin/* and /psychologist/* used to live here under KZ-210; that decision was reversed on review (PRO-337) and both panels are now localized like any other area, so the guard checks them.
